author: felipeblassioli
abstract: Structured code-review skill for PRs and diffs with focused review lenses for HTTP services, scheduled jobs, queue consumers, Kubernetes runtime behavior, observability, and distributed-systems safety. v1.1.0 added cross-cutting lenses for data integrity, multi-tenancy, error model, webhooks, and a senior meta-checklist. v1.2.0 adds an error-handling discipline reference covering the failure / defect / fatal taxonomy, retry classification by error class, actionable error messages, boundary translation, and process-exit discipline.
